name: flow
description: Conductors for software work (dev) and for non-software projects (project), one slice at a time.

model_top.title: Top-tier model
model_top.description: Model for Flow's top tier: an alias like opus or sonnet, or a model ID. Empty means Flow's default for the tier.

model_mid.title: Mid-tier model
model_mid.description: Model for Flow's mid tier: an alias like opus or sonnet, or a model ID. Empty means Flow's default for the tier.

stack_presets.title: Stack presets
stack_presets.description: Skill to use per stack, and for the design tool, as comma-separated pairs stack=skill or design=skill. Example: astro=my-stacks:astro, design=my-design:design-sketchpad
